Riot Shotgun and Minigun resource attribution
=============================================

The first-person sprites, pickup sprites, and sounds used by TuinRPG's Riot
Shotgun and Minigun are adapted from li-gnrcwpn.pk3 (Lippeth Generic Weapons /
Weapons of Saturn), supplied by the project owner for integration.

The upstream credits state that Lippeth granted permission to use resources.
Relevant credited contributors and sources include Lippeth, Tormentor667,
Mike12, perkristian, JoeyTD, Captain J, SgtMarkIV, wildweasel, Ed the Bat,
Patriot1776, LedIris, faslrn, Beautiful Doom, Brutal Doom, Demon Eclipse,
Accessories to Murder, DOOMRL Arsenal, Killing Floor, Return to Castle
Wolfenstein, Doom 3, Raven Software, 2015 Inc., and Valve.

TuinRPG does not import the upstream weapon code or reload systems. It uses
only the relevant visual and audio resources with original TuinRPG behavior.
